video_title: Dillon Brooks Postgame On-Court Interview after Suns win against Sacramento Kings | 11-18-26

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his aggressive playstyle and team effort
quotes.excerpt: I know this is a long road trip, some guys got to step up in each game

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Dillon, a season-high 29 points for you. How are you able to settle in and get into a flow state out there?

text_blocks.speaker: Dillon Brooks
text_blocks.text: I think starting from the right from the beginning when I got the and-one, just trying to be aggressive throughout. I know this is a long road trip, some guys got to step up in each game and I felt like this game was for me to step up.

quotes.social_post: Dillon Brooks on his 29 point performance against the Kings: I think starting from the right from the beginning when I got the and-one, just trying to be aggressive throughout. I know this is a long road trip, some guys got to step up.

structured.context: Dillon Brooks discusses his aggressive offensive performance and his mindset during the game against the Sacramento Kings.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on his competitive matchup with De'Aaron Fox
quotes.excerpt: I love when guys compete, and he's a competitor. He came out to play, he showed me a lot.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Looking at that third quarter, it looked like De'Aaron Fox kind of chirped you a little bit. Did that maybe motivate you and fire you up some?

text_blocks.speaker: Dillon Brooks
text_blocks.text: I love when guys compete, and he's a competitor. He came out to play, he showed me a lot. Me and him going back and forth, going back and forth in baskets, I like that. I like it a lot.

quotes.social_post: Dillon Brooks on his competitive back and forth with DeAaron Fox: I love when guys compete, and he is a competitor. He came out to play, he showed me a lot. Me and him going back and forth in baskets, I like that.

structured.context: Dillon Brooks reacts to a question about his competitive back-and-forth matchup with De'Aaron Fox during the third quarter.

quotes.speaker: Dillon Brooks
quotes.summary_phrase: Dillon Brooks on the Suns' defensive intensity in the second half
quotes.excerpt: We knew we had to get back in the game and we kind of did in that third quarter.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: The defensive tenacity really picked up there in the second half. You guys forced five turnovers in the third quarter. What was said at halftime to motivate you even more?

text_blocks.speaker: Dillon Brooks
text_blocks.text: We knew we had to get back in the game and we kind of did in that third quarter. And then slowly we figured it out, gaining our physicality, getting to the ball more, making them feel us, making them take more tougher shots in the paint and it slowly wore on them.

quotes.social_post: Dillon Brooks on the Suns defensive intensity in the second half: We knew we had to get back in the game. Gaining our physicality, getting to the ball more, making them feel us, making them take more tougher shots in the paint.

structured.context: Dillon Brooks explains the defensive adjustments and increased physicality the Suns utilized in the second half to overcome the Kings.
